clusters.name: DECLARATIVE_GOVERNANCE_WITHOUT_EXECUTABLE_ENFORCEMENT
clusters.root: Rules and engines existed, but production artifacts did not require machine-verifiable route attestations before user exposure.
clusters.fix: Production gate + authorized engine route + exposure gate.

clusters.name: AUTHORITY_LAYER_INVERSION
clusters.root: Presentation/raster/generative layers could act before or above geometry/semantic authority.
clusters.fix: L0-L2 immutable serial authority; L3-L6 subordinate; L7 validation; L8 exposure.

clusters.name: REFERENCE_KNOWLEDGE_NOT_COMPILED
clusters.root: Reference mining produced prose but not deterministic design tokens or observable output expectations.

clusters.name: PASS_SEMANTICS_COLLAPSED
clusters.root: Technical pass, engine pass and visual/product pass were treated as interchangeable.
clusters.fix: Independent blocking gates and claim-level truthfulness.

clusters.name: EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS_AND_CLAIM_BOUNDARY_WEAK
clusters.root: Timestamp and narrative inference could outrank content/evidence state.
